name: UPM
notes: Demonstration template based on common UPM kertas kerja conventions. Not an official university document. Verify formatting against current university guidelines before submission.

sections.name: Cover Page
sections.description: Title page with university logo, programme title, organiser, and date

sections.name: Pengenalan
sections.description: Introduction and rationale for the programme

sections.name: Latar Belakang
sections.description: Background of the programme and organising body

sections.name: Objektif Program
sections.description: Programme objectives listed as bullet points

sections.name: Butiran Program
sections.description: Date, time, venue, target participants, and programme scope

sections.name: Kumpulan Sasaran
sections.description: Target participant details and estimated attendance

sections.name: Jawatankuasa Penganjur
sections.description: List of organising committee members with positions

sections.name: Tentatif Program
sections.description: Programme itinerary with time slots and activities in table format

sections.name: Belanjawan Kewangan
sections.description: Itemised budget table with quantities, unit prices, and totals

sections.name: Hasil Yang Dijangka
sections.description: Expected outcomes and benefits of the programme

sections.name: Kesimpulan
sections.description: Concluding remarks and hope for approval

sections.name: Lampiran
sections.description: Supporting documents, forms, and additional references

approvalFlow.notes: Advisor reviews and signs the proposal
